title: PlayerStatusRecord
description: Current roster and injury/practice status for one canonical player, keyed once by player_id rather than duplicated across every tier and arbitrage row (ADR-043). NEVER A MODEL INPUT: no field here may enter a projection, a VORP, a fair rank, a tier or an arbitrage score. Since contract 1.1 (ADR-101) the downstream availability policy may read these fields to decide whether a player is actionable in a decision surface (Start/Sit verdicts, actionable ROS lists, Trade targets and budgets, Pick of the Week); that changes eligibility and presentation, never a published number. Optional injury and practice fields are null for healthy players by design, because Sleeper legitimately omits them; a null is absence of a report, never a clearance.

current_team.description: The club that employs him now under employment_evidence_v1 (ADR-102): the current-season roster, then a fresh Sleeper record. Null when he is verified unsigned, retired, or his employment is unknown; never a previous club.

availability_override.description: A reviewed entry from config/availability-overrides.yaml in force for this build (ADR-101), or null. Records reliable public reporting that the player's season is over, which neither feed can express. The availability policy honours it only while a feed still shows the player on a reserve list or injured reserve; it never changes a model number.

employment_status.description: Contract 1.2 (ADR-102), employment_evidence_v1. signed: the current-season nflverse roster lists him with a code other than CUT/RET, or (off that roster) a Sleeper record no older than 48 hours names a club. unsigned: off the current roster (or CUT) and a fresh Sleeper record names no club with status Active — a free agent. retired: the current roster says RET. unknown: no current evidence settles it; never shown as FA. Null when the build computed no reading. Eligibility and presentation only, never a model input.

employment_source.description: Which source decided employment_status; null when unknown.

employment_observed_at_utc.description: When the deciding source was observed: the build time for the roster file (fetched by the build), the capture time for Sleeper.
